facts.text: Alfred University's Inamori School of Engineering is one of only two U.S. institutions offering a BS in Ceramic Engineering and the only institution in the nation offering degrees in glass science.

sources.title: NYS College of Ceramics | Alfred University
sources.quote: The Inamori School of Engineering is one of only two institutions in the US that offer a BS in Ceramic Engineering and the only institution in the US that offers degrees in glass science.
